newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Swiss Glencore wins Sri Lanka diesel/jet tender.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Glencore wins Sri Lanka diesel/jet tender.

text.p: Sri Lanka's state-owned Ceylon Petroleum Corp (CPC) awarded a 200,000-barrel diesel and jet fuel tender to Swiss trader Glencore, a CPC official said on Thursday.
"We have decided to award the tender to Glencore," the official told Reuters.
Glencore's price of $0.89 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes was the best among the six offers the tender had attracted, the official said.

The contract comprises 160,000 barrels of diesel (gas oil) and 40,000 barrels of jet fuel. The premium level is the same for both 1.0-percent sulpher diesel and jet fuel on a c-and-f basis to Colombo for October 11-12 delivery.
In the last tender, Sri Lanka bought 145,000 barrels of diesel from Caltex at around $1.77 per barrel above Singapore spot quotes for September 19-20 delivery, c- and-f Colombo.
